hub.headline: Serious Engine 1 was Croteam's engine for Serious Sam: The First Encounter and The Second Encounter.
hub.next: Build version 1.10 from Croteam's release with a current compiler and record which disabled SDK parts a working build needs.
hub.what_it_was: A hardware-accelerated 3D engine from 2001 built around large open levels, many enemies on screen and brush-based level geometry, with its own editor.
hub.what_survives: Croteam published version 1.10 of the source on 11 March 2016 under GPL-2.0. Game data is not included, and some third-party SDK parts are excluded or carry their own licences.

name: Serious Engine 1
summary: Croteam's engine for the first Serious Sam games, released as source under GPL-2.0 in 2016.
